comment: This version has no DEL, ADD or RND buttons and no stored patterns, so the register is shaped by the CTR knob and the CLR jack alone. The census output order is Out first and Trig second, which matches the panel from top to bottom. The LEN knob comes up at 8 here rather than the 16 the full randLoops uses. The TRG output has no family because Trig Output type changes what it carries.
